VTS Scoring Log

Verified Peptides

US-facing gray market· Lyophilized vials, powders· Scored July 2026· verifiedpeptides.com →
80 /100
High Transparency
500+ published third-party COAs publicly viewable on a dedicated Lab Tests page, each verifiable with the testing lab. Founded 2020, testing since 2019. Multi-parameter testing: HPLC purity, sterility, endotoxin (LPS), and net peptide content. The strongest public COA footprint of any vendor scored to date. Primary gap: COA browsing is by product rather than searchable by lot number, and policy documentation could be more specific on quality incidents.

Community Signal
Independent Test Results
Verified Peptides' position as an early adopter of public third-party COA publishing (2019-2020) gives them a longer verifiable testing archive than most competitors. Community members have referenced the Lab Tests page as a credibility signal. Independent community-commissioned blind-buy testing results not identified in public archives as of July 2026.
Community Experience
Generally positive community references for COA transparency. Reputation is primarily built on the public lab archive rather than independent community testing. Some community members note catalog size is narrower than some competitors, focusing on a curated rather than comprehensive approach.
Scoring Notes
The public COA archive is the differentiator
500+ published COAs verifiable with the testing lab is a meaningful commitment. The discipline of publishing every batch result - including any that might underperform - is the signal that separates genuine transparency from marketing. The archive predates this scoring and cannot be retroactively curated, which is itself an authenticity signal.
What would push to a higher High Transparency score
A lot-number-searchable COA interface (rather than product-browseable), explicit mass spectrometry identity confirmation in the testing protocol, and more specific quality-incident policy documentation would strengthen the score further within the High band.
